text:
incident-bot: SLO alert (AUTO): realtime-api.euw1 p99 spiked above SLO (threshold 900ms). Detection rule: realtime_p99 > 900ms for 3m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/realtime/p95-p99?orgId=1

maya_oncall: seeing it, joining bridge. @eli_sre you up? paging now :rotating_light:

eli_sre: on it. looking at the p95/p99 panels and streaming tail metrics. initial read: p95 jumped from ~180ms to ~520ms, p99 from ~820ms to ~2.1s in the last 2m.

sam_runtime: I'll check kvcache and batching. Quick check: `rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])` looks like a ramp 4x starting ~7601239600. Also `streaming_active_connections` is normal.

eli_sre: good call. KV miss rate aligns with tail latency. suspect evictions from recent deploy (auto-rollout 7601200000).

maya_oncall: ops-bot, trigger runbook step1 (limit incoming burst + enable canary fallback route).

ops-bot: runbook task started: "realtime-latency-quick-mitigation". Step 1: add temporary rate limit 20rps per user. Step 2: force route policy -> fallback-compact-model.

jon_prod: FYI we have a customer thread reporting degraded interactive experience for EU region. Tess, can support message customers?

tess_support: on it. I'll notify impacted customers in eu-west-1 with short note and offer status updates. Asking CS to gather affected org ids.

sam_runtime: applying fallback to `redwood-compact-v2` on euw1 for streaming endpoints. Command: ```
# route change (dry run shown)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/routes/route-switch \
  -d '{"route":"realtime","from":"realtime-standard","to":"redwood-compact-v2","region":"euw1","force":true}'
```

eli_sre: while thats rolling, i'm tailing the runtime logs for KV eviction reasons. snippet: ```
2026-03-17T12:00:15Z runtime[pid=4123]: kv_cache: evict LRU batch_size=4096 mem_pressure=0.92
2026-03-17T12:00:16Z runtime[pid=4123]: kernel_sel: using fallback kernel for attention, latency += 40ms
```

maya_oncall: routing change accepted, fallback enabled. p95 trending down to ~260ms after route flip (observed 30s after change). p99 still ~1.1s but improving.

eli_sre: investigating root cause: increased ephemeral memory pressure on a subset of hosts causes aggressive KV evictions which blow up token generation cold starts. correlating with autoscaling events around 7601239500.

sam_runtime: suggestion: temporarily reduce per-request max tokens for realtime to 512 to reduce KV churn and throttle background batch compactions. Will push a config tweak now.

ops-bot: config change applied: `realtime.max_tokens=512` for euw1 (canary). Monitor for 5m.

tess_support: customer notifications sent to 3 affected enterprise customers. will update with ETA after next check.

eli_sre: quick dashboard checks: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])) by (host)` shows 6 hosts with spikes. Opening host->stack traces for postmortem.

maya_oncall: handing off monitoring to eli for postmortem and to sam for runtime changes. i'll stay on 30m watch. If p99 > 1.5s for >2m escalate to SEV-1 paging.

jon_prod: good mitigation path. please capture timeline and diff of deploys for the cluster for the postmortem.

eli_sre: noted. capturing logs, traces, traces link: https://tracing.redwood/trace?query=realtime.euw1

sam_runtime: early hypothesis: kernel fallback + eviction cascade due to a config regression in 7601200000. I'll open PR to revert the mem-based eviction tuning.

maya_oncall: current numbers 3m after mitigations: p95=220ms, p99=480ms. marking incident as mitigated, not resolved. leave thread open for postmortem artifacts.

ops-bot: Incident note auto-saved to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/7601239876. Runbook steps executed: rate-limit, route-fallback, max_tokens tweak.

tess_support: keeping customers updated. next update at +20m or earlier if status changes.

eli_sre: will collect host-level heap profiles and KV eviction traces, attaching to incident. planning root cause RCA and mitigation PR.

maya_oncall: thanks all — handing off long-lived RCA to eli and sam. I'll remain on-call for 30m. If anything flares, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
